n: <int> Number of real activities in the project.
num_activities: <int> Total number of activities including the fictitious project-start and project-end activities.
num_resources: <int> Number of partially renewable resources available to the project.

{activity_id}.processing_time: <int> Duration for which the activity runs continuously once started.

resource_demands.{resource_id}: <int> Per-period consumption of the resource while the activity is in execution.

temporal_constraints: <list[dict], length num_constraints> Each entry specifies a sequencing relationship between two activities with fields 'i' (first activity), 'j' (second activity), and 'delta' (minimum time lag requiring that the start of activity j minus the start of activity i is at least delta).

{resource_id}.capacity: <int> Maximum total consumption allowed across all activities for this resource over its designated periods.
{resource_id}.periods: <list[int]> Subset of periods within the planning horizon during which this resource is available.
